spans.s:
नेतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be led or guided or con-
ducted, to be led away, to be taken, to be carried.
नेतव्य नेतव्य, नेतृ, &c. See p. 511, col. 2.

नेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, leading, conducting, guiding,
one who brings or leads to; (ता), m. a leader, guide,
conductor; a chief, master, owner; (with दण्डस्य)
an inflicter of punishment [cf. दण्ड-न्˚]; the hero
of a drama or play; the plant Azadirachta Indica
(= निम्ब); the numeral two; (त्री), f. a female
leader; a river; a vein; an epithet of Lakṣmī.
—नेतृ-त्व, अम्, n. the office or business of a
[]
leader &c., leadership.
—नेतृ-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
containing the word नेतृ.

नेत्र, अस्, ई, अम्, one who guides or leads, a
leader, guide; a substitute for नेतृ at the end of a
comp. (e. g. भवन्-नेत्र, having thee as com-
mander); (अस्), m., N. of a son of Dharma and
father of Kunti; also a son of Su-mati; (अम्), n.
leading, conducting; the eye (as the instrument of
leading or guiding); symbolic expression for the
number two; the string with which a churning-stick
is whirled round; an enema-pipe; the root of a tree;
bleached or wove silk; a carriage.
—नेत्र-कनी-
निका, f. the pupil of the eye.
—नेत्र-कोष, अस्,
m. the eyeball; the bud of a flower.
—नेत्र-गो-
चर, अस्, आ, अम्, within the range of the sight,
visible.
—नेत्र-च्छद, अस्, m. the eyelid.
—नेत्र-
ज, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘eye-born,’ coming from the eyes; (अम्),
n. a tear.
—नेत्र-जल, अम्, n. ‘eye-water,’ tears.
—नेत्र-ता, f. the state of being an eye; नेत्रतां
या, to become an eye.
—नेत्र-त्रिभाग-ब्रह्म-
यशस्विन्, ई, m., N. of an author.
—नेत्र-पर्यन्त,
अस्, आ, अम्, as far as to the eye, up to the eye; (अस्),
m. the outer angle of the eye.
—नेत्र-पिण्ड, अस्,
m. a cat (‘having full eyes’); the eyeball.
—नेत्र-
पुष्करा, f. a species of plant; [cf. रुद्र-जटा.]
—नेत्र-मनः-स्वभावास्, m. pl. eyes, mind,
and soul.
—नेत्र-मीना, f. a species of plant (=
यव-तिक्ता).
—नेत्र-मुष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, stealing or cap-
tivating the eye.
—नेत्र-योनि, इस्, m. an epithet of
Indra (as covered with marks resembling the female
organ, through the curse of Gautama, whose wife
Ahalyā he had attempted to seduce; the sage after-
wards relenting, changed these disgraceful marks on
the body of the deity to as many eyes); the moon
(as produced from the eye of Atri).
—नेत्र-रञ्जन,
अम्, n. ‘eye-colouring,’ collyrium.
—नेत्र-रुज्, क्,
f. disease of the eyes.
—नेत्र-रोग, अस्, m. disease
of the eyes, ophthalmia; (अस्, आ, अम्), afflicted with
disease of the eyes.
—नेत्ररोग-ता, f. disease of the
eyes.
—नेत्ररोग-हन्, आ, m. a particular plant used
for diseases of the eyes, Tragia Involucrata.
—नेत्र-
रोमन्, अ, n. the eyelash.
—नेत्र-वस्ति, इस्, m. f.
a clyster-pipe with a bag.
—नेत्र-वस्त्र, अम्, n. a
veil over the eye.
—नेत्र-वारि, n. ‘eye-water,’
tears.
—नेत्र-विष्, ट्, f. excretion of the eyes.
—नेत्र-विष, अस्, आ, अम्, having poison in the
eyes.
—नेत्र-स्तम्भ, अस्, m. rigidity of the eyes.
—नेत्राञ्जन (˚र-अञ्˚), अम्, n. ‘eye-ointment,’
collyrium.
—नेत्रान्त (˚र-अन्˚), अस्, m. the outer
corner of the eye.
—नेत्राभिष्यन्द (˚र-अभ्˚),
अस्, m. running of the eyes.
—नेत्रामय (˚र-
आम्˚), अस्, m. ophthalmia.
—नेत्राम्बु (˚र-अम्˚)
or नेत्राम्भस् (˚र-अम्˚), अस्, n. ‘eye-water,’
tears.
—नेत्रारि (˚र-अरि), इस्, m. a species of plant
(= सीहुण्ड).
—नेत्रोत्सव (˚र-उत्˚), अम्, n. ‘eye-
feast,’ any pleasing or beautiful object.
—नेत्रोपम
(˚र-उप्˚), अम्, n. the almond fruit (as resembling
eyes).
—नेत्रोपम-फल, अस्, m. the almond
tree.
—नेत्रौषध (˚र-औष्˚), अम्, n. medi-
cine for the eyes, collyrium, green sulphate of iron
used as collyrium; (ई), f. Odina Pinnata (= अज-
शृङ्गी).
नेत्र नेत्र, नेत्रिक, &c. See p. 511, col. 3.
नेत्रिक, अम्, n. a pipe, a clyster-pipe; a ladle.
